messages:
Ivy: Quick quarterly thread 
I ran the recurrence analysis for the last 90 days (link: https://redwood.internal/reports/incidents/q90) and want to lock owners for the top recurring patterns so follow-ups actually close. Top buckets by frequency/cost: (1) downstream throttles -> queue pileups, (2) autoscaler config drift, (3) overlapping canary windows.

Noah: drop the top-line numbers?

Ivy: Summary numbers: 42% throttles (highest infra churn), 26% autoscaler drift, 18% canary overlap, 14% misc (cache auth, etc). Estimated monthly ops cost tied to throttles ~high.

Sasha: Agree we should target small, testable mitigations first then automation. Also add a regression column in the tracker so PMs can see which incidents are regressions vs new causes.

Ken: I can own (1) throttles. Plan: per-host leaky bucket + immediate shed + dashboard + alert. Minimal change first, global quota as follow-up. ETA: 2026-06-08.

Noah: I'll take (2) autoscaler drift. Plan: CI lint + nightly config comparator job that opens a MR when drift detected. ETA: 2026-05-31.

Sasha: I'll own (3) canary guardrails: add a preflight that prevents overlapping active model IDs, plus a short runbook snippet for rollbacks. ETA: 2026-06-05.

PagerBot: Follow-up created: INC-RECUR-2026-1609 assigned -> Ken, Noah, Sasha. Due 2026-06-12.

Ivy: I'll add columns in the tracker: "owner", "ETA", "regression?", "est monthly cost avoided", and "postmortems tagged". I'll post the CSV link here once updated.

Ken: Blocker: need a staging harness to simulate downstream throttles. Opening INF-5087 and will cc infra. If infra can't fast-track, I'll prototype a local stub.

Noah: I'll open INF-5088 for config-test access and tag CI infra. If blocked, I'll fall back to a unit-test-only lint to land quicker.

Sasha: Small request: can we schedule a 20m recurring meeting to keep these follow-ups light? Wednesdays 14:30 PT?

Ivy: That works. I'll schedule monthly 20m starting 2026-05-20 14:30 PT and add a lightweight agenda: review tracker changes, unblock tickets, quick PR links.

Ken: I'll target opening the mitigation PR by 2026-06-01 and link tests in the follow-up ticket.

Noah: PR for autoscaler lint will be up by 2026-05-28.

Sasha: Preflight + runbook PR by 2026-06-03.

Ivy: Great 
Closing: owners update the tracker and the follow-up ticket with PR/ticket IDs by ETAs. If blocked, post the blocker ticket ID in-thread. I'll surface a short summary to #eng-weekly after the first sprint.

All: ack
